name: Newsroom OS – Editorial Control & AI Assistant
author: koskar22

sections.description:
Control your editorial team. Improve content quality. Publish faster.

Newsroom OS transforms WordPress into a complete editorial control system.
Designed for publishers, editors, and teams who want full visibility over their content workflow — without relying on multiple plugins.

👥 Who is this for?

  • News websites with multiple authors
  • Editors who want control over content quality and deadlines
  • Publishers tired of using separate tools for SEO, tasks, and internal linking

⚡ The Decision Engine (Your biggest advantage)

Stop overwhelming writers with checklists.

Newsroom OS analyzes every article in real-time and shows:

  • Publish Confidence Score (0–100%)
  • Next Best Action (what to fix first)
  • Live SEO & structure insights

👉 Your writers always know exactly what to do next.

✍️ Editorial Control (Dashboard)

Manage your entire newsroom from one place:

  • Assign articles with deadlines and priority
  • Track active tasks and missed deadlines
  • Detect articles missing SEO data instantly
  • Monitor competitors via RSS feeds
  • Identify content gaps in your coverage

🧠 Writer Assistant (Inside the Editor)

A powerful sidebar that guides every writer:

  • Headline Score (optimize titles instantly)
  • Live SEO Checklist (meta, links, length)
  • Smart Tag Suggestions
  • Internal Link Suggestions (1-click insert)
  • Trend Radar (see what people search right now)
  • Quick Actions (FAQ, Key Points, Timeline)

🔗 Story & SEO Engine

Turn every article into a content hub:

  • Automatic Story Timeline (based on related articles)
  • Smart Internal Linking clusters
  • Clean, optimized Article & NewsArticle schema
  • Improved session time and pageviews

🤖 Built-in AI Tools (No API Required)

  • Auto-generate FAQ sections from your content
  • Extract Key Takeaways automatically
  • Ready-to-use AI prompts for titles, SEO & structure

🧠 Example Workflow

  1. Editor assigns a story with a deadline
  2. Writer opens the editor and sees:
    • what’s trending
    • what to fix next
  3. The system highlights missing SEO or weak structure
  4. Internal links and timeline are added instantly

👉 Faster publishing, better content, full control.

🔥 Why Newsroom OS?

Unlike traditional SEO plugins, Newsroom OS focuses on editorial control and decision-making — not just metadata.

It acts as a real-time assistant for your entire team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/newsroom-os directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Run the onboarding wizard to configure your newsroom.
  4. Start assigning tasks and optimizing content.
